findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - fix a blocking sign-off finding and retry acceptance.
Passing `images=set()` filters only the current snapshot. In `run()`, lines 882–894 build the review base from the previous original product commit, retaining its images; lines 898–902 remove images only from the new snapshot. Consequently, every existing SVG appears as a deletion in the retry's reviewed diff, sending image contents through code review again. Previous reviews persist through `records.py:453–454`, so this affects ordinary review retries. Apply the exclusion to both sides of the comparison. The new test covers only the first acceptance attempt and misses this failure.
